def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Divider lines are the rows/columns that are otherwise a single color;
    # occasional colored junctions may interrupt them.
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
            if max(row.count(c) for c in set(row)) >= w - 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(w)
            if max(sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(h))
                   for color in {grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) >= h - 2]

    # The common interior color fills unmarked crossings.
    from collections import Counter
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    line_color = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    fill = freq.most_common(2)[1][0]

    marked = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols)

    r0, r1 = min(i for i, j in marked), max(i for i, j in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(j for i, j in marked), max(j for i, j in marked)

             else grid[rows[i]][cols[j]]
